description:
[German XRechnung 3.0 & ZUGFeRD 2.2 / Factur-X cross-compiler & validator. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Compiles and validates electronic invoices conforming to German national standards (KoSIT XRechnung 3.0 and hybrid PDF/A-3 ZUGFeRD 2.2), verifying Leitweg-ID routing codes and German B2B mandate compliance under the Wachstumschancengesetz.
Usage: Use this tool to prepare invoices for German federal/state public sector (B2G) and German domestic B2B transactions.
Returns: JSON object with { invoiceId: string, targetFormat: string, profileApplied: string, isLeitwegIdValid: boolean, isValidForGermanB2G: boolean, isGermanB2bMandateCompliant: boolean, xmlMetadataSnippet: string, taxAssessment: object }.

buyerName.description: Legal name of customer or German contracting authority

grossAmountEur.description: Total gross invoice amount in EUR

netAmountEur.description: Total net taxable amount in EUR

isGermanPublicSectorB2G.description: Whether the recipient is a German public authority requiring strict Leitweg-ID validation

leitwegIdOrBuyerReference.description: German Leitweg-ID routing code (e.g. 991-12345-67) or buyer reference

sellerVatOrTaxNumber.description: Seller German VAT ID (USt-IdNr. DE...) or Steuernummer

name: xrechnung_zugferd_cross_compiler
